text: My cat had been having some serious gastrointestinal issues and had not been eating well.  The vet gave us some powder medicine to mix in her food that he admitted would taste REALLY bad. And I was supposed to do this twice a day?  It was a disaster from the start.  So I went searching for a solution and found these.  Once I got them, I made myself a tiny funnel from some paper, and used an itty bitty measuring spoon to pour the right amount of the medicine into the caplets.  I then used a pill shooter that I also got on Amazon and just shot the pill down her throat twice a day.  Sooooo much easier.

title: PERFECT alternative for the 1" deep return filters.
text:
These things are PERFECT for your house. The 1" create too much resistance on a high MERV rated filter, especially when it is getting dirty.

These work perfect and in the end I will probably break even ($) on this 5" VS the 1" filters I was replacing every 30-45 days.

A trick I am using. I went to Lowe's and purchased a foam pre-filter that is supposed to go on a window AC unit. It is a thin gray/black foam sheet. I have it over this filter as a "Pre-Filter" to catch all the LARGE debris that would ultimately shorten the life of the 5" filter. 1x/month I take the foam filter and rinse it out and lay it back on the 5" filter. The foam is so thin it creates VERY little air resistance.

Another thing I noticed is the HVAC is quieter with these filters. When I would install 1" there was always a "whistle" as the air passes through the filter, even when it was new. With this 5" is is quiet, much less resistance.

The filter fit perfect into the 1" filter housing, no modifications needed. I did add a foam rubber, self adhesive weather strip (like this [[ASIN:B0025KUSXW Duck 1297116 Self Adhesive Weatherstrip 17 Feet]] to inside face of the 1" metal housing. This created a better seal between the filter and the surrounding housing. Making the air go THROUGH the filter, not AROUND it.

title: Perfect fit!
text:
A friend of mine told me about this trick where you use one of these in place of a standard 20x20x1 filter. I ordered a couple and they do fit! They’ve only been in for a little while and the biggest thing I’ve noticed is the air flow through the filter is much quieter. The old washable I had in there didn’t seem to be letting as much air through because it had a lot of pressure differential across the filter with the blower motor running. This has a lot less pressure differential. And the airflow from the registers has increased notably; at least that’s what it feels like across my foot when I stand on one of the registers.

I will update this review if anything changes. Hopefully I get a good long life out of these with their larger capacity for dust.

title: Amazing results
text:
I would have given 4 stars due to lack of instructions, but the final result is so amazing it made up for it! I watched a lot of tutorials on youtube, and there's some mixed info regarding how much product to use, how long to leave it on, in what order, and if it's okay to wet them or use mascara in the first 24 hours. This is the method that worked for me:
1) Start with clean & dry lashes. Mine are very long but straight, so it really helped to use an eyelash curler before staring everything. If I didn't have good vision, I would have had a hard time doing his on my own without help (since you have to look in a mirror up close during the process).
2) Select a rod size or pink silicone size relative to your lash length. The sticky white rods were too small for me, and a pain to use. I used the size L pink silicone (you will receive size S, M & L).
**Do one eye at a time**
3) Put lash glue on your eyelid and on the smooth/flat part of the silicone rod that will go against your skin. Wait about 1 or 2 minutes before pressing onto your lid, that way the glue is a bit tacky and it will stick. When it's freshly wet, it won't stick too good. I learned this the hard way. Press the pad gently on your lid for a few minutes. If there are gaps at the edges & you can't seem to get it to stay, don't worry, once you get glue on the lashes it'll pull it down against your skin. Just to make use of more tools in the kit, I used the pink round air pump thingy to shoot air onto the silicone pad with glue, so that the glue would dry faster. I think that helped a bit.
4) Work in little sections! Put lash glue on a few lashes, and use the white thin tool (the thin edge, but on its side) to slide & press your lashes upwards and onto the pink silicone pad. Keep doing this until they stick. Add a little more glue if you have to. When the glue starts to dry, lashes stick a little easier. Once the lash section is stuck on the silicone pad, use the pointed white part of the tool to separate lashes that clump together on the silicone. Repeat this in tiny sections until you finish your whole eye.This step is what takes the longest.
5) Use one of the little green sticks with small round felt tip, dip it in jar A, and work in sections layering it on your lashes (you'll have to dip for more product). I did not put a big glob of product. I went over all my lashes about twice with it, dipping it a few times in the jar, but being careful not to overdo it and get it in my eye. I left this on 12 minutes.
6) With clean q-tips, wipe product from jar A off. I went from root to tip, rotating the q-tip, and I used several. Then, I dipped another q-tip in warm water and went over my lashes again. I was afraid the little bit of water would mess up the process, but it didn't.
7) Rinse and pat dry the little green stick, dip it in jar B, and repeat the process above. This product gave me a tiny slight tingle in my eye, about halfway through, but I had no redness and no irritation. I was extra careful when I did my second eye, and it happened again. Not sure why. I left the product from jar B for 10 minutes.
8) Repeat the q-tip cleaning process.
9) Now for the other two jars...this is where I had no idea what I was doing, but I got great results regardless :) I dipped a q-tip in jar C and wiped my lashes with it. Then I did the same with a fresh q-tip in jar D. The q-tip combined with jar D seemed to loosen my lashes from the silicone, but I still needed extra help with get the glue off.
10) The lash glue was a mess. It was everywhere & not really coming off. I used neutrogena oil free eye makeup remover with a cotton ball on entire eye/lid, as if I was removing makeup, and it came off right away! For my second eye, I dipped Q-tips in the neutrogena eye makeup remover and wiped my lashes on the silicone with it & they came off easily. Then I began wedging a q-tip with makeup remover behind the silicone pad against my eyelid to gently unstick the silicone pad from my skin. I still had to wipe my entire eye with a cotton ball & eye makeup remover at the end to get every trace of glue off.

-I put a teeny bit of the mascara that came in the bag, and snapped the pictures. I don't know how this isn't the most popular beauty trend ever. It's incredible how amazing my lashes look!

title: Awesome!!
text:
I'm really glad I purchased this! It saves a lot of money and time!

Shipping: I receive my item super fast!! Within 4 dayss

Product: Overall, I received that was described. All safe and package well. Enough supplies for 80+ eyelash lifts!

Application: The same day I received it I tried it out instantly and I love the results!! My lash and naturally curly and healthy now.
Step 1: Make sure eyes are clean and dry. Prepare your tools even the ones that aren't included. Q-tips, warm water and any type of make-up remover.
Step 2: Use the Sticky Perm Rod or Silicone Pad S,M,L. I used the Large Silicone Pad, then applied glue to the smooth side to stick to my eyelid, make sure it's as close to your lash line as possible. The glue can get a bit tricky but just be patient, once the Silicone Pad is secure apply glue on to the other side and begin the lifting motions in section with either the long white tool or the little black brush. Brush, apply more glue, repeat that till your lash are fully glued to the Pad and notice the glue is starting to build up. Then begin to separate clumped sections with the white tool.
Step 3: After you secure all your lashes on the Pad or Rod take Formula A. Apply evenly with the green felt tool and let it sit for 12-10 minutes. Make sure you have the under eye Cotton Pad applied while using the Formulas because they do sting a bit.
Step 4: Once the time is up take the warm water and Q-Tips and begin removing slowly Formula A, in upward motions starting from the roots to the tip of your lashes. Just make sure you don't complete remove the glue though.
Step 5: Now apply Formula B evenly with a new green felt tool and let it sit for 10 minutes. And repeat the product removal step once the time is up. After every Formula removal make sure you just have glue remaining, no extra product, you don't want to mix them.
Step 6: Formula C! It's has a consistency of an oil so you can apply it with the black brush, apply small doses because it does help separate and move lashes a little easier. Let this sit for 5 minutes and repeat the removal process.
Step 7: Just like Formula C, Formula D has the same oil base consistency, apply this one for 5 minutes.
Step 8: OPTIONAL: apply Growth Mascara for 5 minutes.
Step 9: It's time for cleaning up finally. Water will not change lashes so you'll be fine. I lifted my Silicone Pad and slowing became cleaning my eye with warm water and Coconut Oil, I use that as a make up remover. It will lift the glue instantly and nourish your lashes. I did my first eye with a benefit make up remover and it took longer to remove, the Coconut Oil was most effective!

After you have one eye down repeat these steps!

title: My eyelashes are amazing after using this!
text:
I am IN LOVE with my eyelashes. I used to have great eyelashes when I was in highschool but after having children- and now being 30 years old, my eyelashes were not my best feature. 2 months ago I started using Rapidlash which really helped my lashes grow longer. After seeing the increase in length I started to be more interested in getting a lash lift. After watching several videos on youtube I decided I could do it myself. Disclaimer- I did go to cosmetology school so I already feel comfortable with this type of a product.

This kit includes so many items- everything you could possibly need (well, I did use some q-tips as well) and a lot of pieces that I didn't use too. I recommend doing 1 eye at a time and taking your time to be very careful to not get any solution in your eye.
-I used the largest size of the pink silicone molds and cut them to fit my eyelid.
-I put a little glue on my eyelid and a little glue on the back of the silicone mold. I waited a minute or two for it to get tacky then placed it on my eyelid as close to my lash line as I could and then held it in place for a couple of minutes to make sure it was glued. I had a slight problem with the edges not staying glued down but this didn't negatively affect the perming for me.
-I then put some of the glue on the silicone mold and waited a minute for it to get tacky.
-I then used the metal tweezers to glue my eyelashes onto the mold making sure they were all straight on the mold and fanned out evenly (this is very important as it will be permed the way they are placed onto the mold- so don't rush through the step). I used a little extra glue to make sure all eyelashes were stuck in place.
-I then put on solution A (perming solution) with one of the green "brushes" that came with the kit. Once applied I set my alarm for 11 minutes.
-After 11 minutes I used a damp q-tip to wipe off Solution A, redampening the q-tip with each wipe to get the solution off.
-I then applied solution B (neutralizing solution) in the same manner as solution A was applied- again setting my alarm for another 11 minutes.
-After 11 minutes, I used a new damp q-tip to wipe off solution B.
-I then applied solution C (glue remover) with a q-tip. Once the eyelashes were loosened from the silicone mold I then used the solution to remove the mold from my eyelid. I ended up having a lot of sticky residue that wasn't fun to get off but was totally worth it.
-solution D is supposed to help "restore" your eyelashes- I'm not sure it really does anything...

With all perms you don't want to use any other chemical or cleaner on it for the first 24-48 hours so I would not recommend washing your face directly after. I did get in the shower and they were exposed to the water with no problems.

It has now been 2 weeks since I have done my eyelashes as I have not touched my eyelash curler in those two weeks. My eyelashes have a more natural "c" curl to them instead of a crimped curl that an eyelash curler gives. I'm 100% happy with the eyelashes I have right now. They seriously are amazing!! I also recommend getting a "tweezerman" metal eyelash comb for when you apply mascara, it really helps to get the clumps out and keep your eyelashes straight and fanned out.

There is enough product in this kit to do your eyelashes dozens of times- well worth the money. The pink silicone pads you can just wash off and reuse.

title: A health drink that actually tastes good...make that DELICIOUS!
text:
Wow! I was stunned the first time I tried this energy shake. The most I hoped for was that it might taste half-way decent, but to my very pleasant surprise, it tasted wonderful! It was not a feat of iron-willpower at all to drink. I wasn't stopping to gag a little every few seconds, like I have with other health drinks. I think it tastes like an oatmeal cookie, but creamy, and when I looked at the can's label, the product was described as having a "creamy granola flavor", so I was pleased that the description was true to the product, unlike other shake powders that tout yumminess and taste like something you wouldn't feed your dog! In addition to delicious flavor, I find that it is very filling, which has been helpful to my dieting efforts, and it definitely boosts my energy. I have always struggled with getting an adequate workout, because I would tire too easily, but after drinking this energy shake, I can really push myself hard and burn significant calories - a first for me! Finally, I feel good about all the vitamins, minerals, and whole food concentrates I am getting with this product, especially since everything is all-natural.

I have used this shake powder with Dole's Peach-Orange-Mango juice, which is really good, but my favorite way to drink it is: 1 scoop energy shake powder; 8 oz. Odwalla Superfood drink; 8 oz. Mountain High all-natural yoghurt (vanilla or lemon); 1 banana. (Actually, this recipe makes enough for me to drink half, and refrigerate the rest for later.) This product mixes well with a blender or salad dressing shaker, but I don't recommend mixing it with a spoon (stays kind of clumpy). Also, I have never used more than 1 scoop in my drinks, and the flavor and consistency have been perfect for me (I think 2 scoops would be too much, but I think 2 scoops are recommended only if you will be mixing it with water, and not something thicker, like juice or milk).

Try this product - it is SO good! I will definitely be re-ordering it when I run out.

title: Excellent Product With Great Results
text:
First thing is first, for full disclosure sake, I am an employee of Beachbody. That, in addition to my extensive marital arts training and fitness lifestyle, makes me hyper critical of all workout and performance supplements. Aside from my sensitivity to caffeine, I generally dismiss a product if it does not have a direct usefulness in the many martial arts practices and competitions (Wrestling, Jiu Jitsu, Judo, Pankration, MMA) I take part in.

I've tried Gatorade, PowerAde, Body Shield, Vitamin Water and a slew of other "Sports Drinks" designed to help rehydrate a body after an intense workout, but I generally have the exact same experience each time. I step onto the mat for my match, fight furiously (I promise that no workout is as intense as 1 on 1 combat) and come off the mat with muscles that are generally blown out and cramped from intense exertion. This wouldn't be a problem if I had loads of time between each match, but I don't and having a constant and flowing use of all my muscles is incredibly important.

Beachbody's Performance line has lots of interesting supplements in it but Hydrate is the one for me and the one product whose effects I notice immediately. Most rehydration liquids do nothing for the cramping that I experience right after trying to choke someone to sleep or rip a limb off, but Hydrate is something special. You don't need to drink a ton in my experience, as a little seems to go a long way. A double serving gets me through a solid 2 hour Jiu Jitsu training situation, and I can't rave about it quite enough during my tournament settings. So far it is the only hydration liquid I have ever noticed to severely cut down or eliminate cramping due to intense exercise, and has generally kept me in the stronger in the game for longer. It is a product I have no desire to train or compete with out.

title: Plug-in sound machine w/timer, nightlight, & 36 sounds – 4.5 stars
text:
[[VIDEOID:cef09eeeef02f0a4588a5360af7c7bf]] This sound machine comes with a total of 36 sounds (i.e. 6 each of fan, white noise, nature, ocean, tones like rain and thunderstorm, and hypnotic sounds). This is NOT battery operated. It is packaged with a USB cable, the unit itself, and a regular instruction pamphlet.

Operation is simple as per my video. All the controls, except for the timer slider and light, are in the front of the unit. I have to "hold press" the ON / OFF button in the front to turn it ON and do the same to turn it OFF.

There are 6 operational buttons  on the front. From left to right, the down arrow moves to the next sound mode, the broken circle cycles through the sound in the current sound mode. The ON/OFF button is in the center and then the minus (decrease) and plus (increase) buttons control the volume.

A tap on the top of the unit turns on the nightlight. There are three  states of light on, light absorption (breathing light), and light off. If I "press hold" it will change the brightness. Despite what I said in my video, I discovered that if I lightly press the ON/OFF button while the sounds are playing, it will suspend the current sound and I will be able to operate this as a nightlight only without the sounds. I did not think I could do that.

The timer slider in the back has only a 30 or 60 minute option or continuous running mode. There is also a headphone jack on the back to the right of the port of the USB cable.

In summary, the sounds on this unit are crisp and clear. It has a larger selection than many units on the market. The nightlight is a nice touch but I wish they had colored lights and I wish this was battery operated. No A/C adapter is included for the USB cable but most people will have one in their house.  The current price of $27.99 is competitively priced for this. Know that there will never be more than 36 sounds available and unless one loves all the sounds, only a few of them will ever be played. I am partial to the sounds of nature myself.

I also like the option of the night light, as well as the option to either set the timer for the sounds or have the unit on a continuous playback. I think an addition of an alarm clock with LED display would have been a great idea. I do wish the machine would have come with the option of a wall plug versus just a USB cable. I was able to plug the cable that came with the machine into my phone charger plug and it seems to work fine that way. The charging instructions are non-existent, simply because the device has no ability to be charged. No matter how long it stays plugged in, the minute you pull the cable, the power is gone. title: Great Machine but only lasted 18 months
text:
I really like this distiller. I has more stainless steel than my previous distillers from Sears. The bottom of the top half is stainless, (it was plastic in my Sears distiller), the spout is stainless and the fan blades are stainless. Nice. The point of failure in my first Sears distiller was the rubber gasket, this machine has a silicone gasket which I expect will last longer and seal better. The company includes a cute little tool (also stainless) that positions the spout over the receiving bottle. I had never seen one before, but I enjoy using it, and it keeps dust out of the bottle as it fills. I really can't complain about my Sears distillers. I bought two and they have given me 23 years of service. Over the years various parts have failed, but I was able to swap them with each other. The only criticism I have of the Tinton is I wish it had a knob on the top so it could easily be lifted off.
Also I received the distiller one week after ordering it, Amazon had estimated a much longer delivery time.
Update: It is now Jan 31, 2016 and the machine no longer works. It did not come with a contact number or trouble shooting guide. The past few weeks it was cycling on and off every 5 minutes, as if it was too hot and automatically turning itself off. There are small burn/melt marks next to the 'ON' button. It will stop working after a small amount of water is distilled--maybe a cup. Since my prior Sears distillers lasted for years, I am disappointed that this machine has died after a year and a half.

title: A good economical distiller with a very minor  drawback
text:
We bought this water distiller at a local big box store as a replacement for the previous model that gave up the ghost last year. We have well water with a very high mineral content and it produces an immense amount of mineral scale in the humidifiers we need in the wintertime. Distilled water is our only option. This particular unit works well and produces a full four liters of distilled water in about four hours. It will take less time if you use hot or boiling water instead of cold water.

A couple of minor points:

- The discharge cap that fits over the jugs opening and under the filter spout to direct the newly distilled water into the jug must be carefully positioned, or the water coming from the spout will drip or splash down the side of the jug and you'll have a pool of water on the countertop or floor. The discharge cap sits loosely on top of the opening, so even if you carefully position it, it can still be moved out of place if you jar the water jug or accidentally bang against it. We use a small plastic funnel instead and it's more efficient and much safer.

- The plastic jug that comes with it is of lesser quality than the jug that came with the previous model. It is thinner and less sturdy and has a very flimsy screw top. We have two older, better quality jugs that we purchased a few years ago with the earlier model and use those. We also have found appropriate, similar containers at a dollar store and use them as well with a funnel.

Cleaning is easy, but instead of buying more of the de-scaler, I follow the suggestion of another reviewer who suggested using vinegar with a little salt. The salt turns the vinegars acetic acid into a weak hydrochloric acid solution and is more efficient.

Aside from the points about the jug and the discharge cap the verdict is that it's a good distiller and with regular cleaning and maintenance is just as good as the much more expensive distillers with the same capacity.

First of all, this thing is made of really hard plastic so when I took it out of the package I thought, "Oh no, this was a total waste of money. How am I going to work this thing?!" It turns out that the stiffness holds your hair much better than the soft fabric kind and adds volume to your bun so it looks bigger. By the way, I have medium length hair.

For those of you who have not worked with this design, you pull your pony tail through the middle and turn the tool twice. Then you pull it through your hair almost to the end of your pony tail and roll it torwards your scalp (up, down, left or right depending on where you want the tail or french twist). When you have rolled your hair to your scalp, you pull the ends together and hook it the tool to itself and you have yourself a nice sturdy bun.

title: Tastes Good, But Ridiculously Overpriced
text:
I have Type II diabetes, so am always looking for ways to cut my blood sugar levels. I was offered this product for free as part of the Amazon Vine program, so I did not really pay any attention to how much it actually sold for. Once I got to the point of writing a review I ended up having to take it into consideration though.

This product is basically just 99% carbonated water with a few amino acids and chromium thrown in. If you have any half-decent diet or take a decent daily multivitamin you are already getting hundreds of times the amount of aminos and chromium that these cans contain and more than you actually need, so it really is not adding anything that you are not already getting.

The rest is just carbonated water, which has an extremely nice taste and texture to it, but is cheap and easy to find at your local grocery store. I can buy 12 oz cans of carbonated water (flavored or unflavored) at Safeway for less than 25 cents each per can. Yet this product sells for more than $2 per can, which is absolutely ridiculous. The Safeway water tastes just as good and comes in a wide variety of flavors. I'm sure that big box stores sell carbonated water for even cheaper than this. While this product tastes o.k., there is nothing "magic" in it and absolutely nothing that would justify paying 8x as much for it as you could find elsewhere.

title: Delicious Donuts without the guilt
text:
I really love the new trend of healthier snacking. I've always been someone who loves food and indulging, but hate the post gluttony regret. With Companies like Jim Buddies coming into play, I can feel a little better about my sweet tooth.

This was my first order and I went with the variety pack. Have to say I really enjoyed these. The donuts are the right stackable size and help curve my sweet tooth. The marcos are on point and are easily worked into my daily calorie intake and you got to love the protein boost (11g). The donut itself is cake like and moist, I was really pleased with the texture. Typically high protein products can be super dense and these were very well done.

If I could make one change I would love to have a glaze, frosting or even like a textural component. I would love to see these with a boost of sweetness as a glaze, powder or frosting. I'm sure this is something these guys are looking into.

I would 100% recommend trying these if you're looking for a healthy donut alternative. Pro-tip microwave for 10 second or toast in the toaster oven for 30 second to warm them up.

title: Shockingly good protein snack

Personally, I'm not a huge fan of the chocolate, but the "glazed" flavor is pretty close. Both are moist and dense, which is to be expected on a protein rich diet. Good news is that they are pretty filling, so you could just eat half, if you just want something to curb a craving. text: I ordered this set of Pill Case - 2 Pack Portable Travel Medicine and Vitamins Organizers. for review as my wife travels for work.  They are very well made.  The purple and pink are very pretty light colors.  It is compact enough to throw into her carry on bag or purse.  The main downfall to this case is that because it is compact 4 of the slots are 1/2 slots and don't always hold a full days supplements.  The compartments each have their own lids, which snap down tightly.  This is a plus in my book, because some of the compact pill carriers we have used,  are at times segmented but only have one snap lid over all the compartments.  Making it difficult to just get one day's dose from them.  My wife will have to take both of these when she travels in order to hold both her night and morning medications and supplements.  Overall, well made, just a little too compact for my wife.  Which may not be a bad thing for others.

title: Couldn’t be more pleased
text:
I take a variety of medicines, and I was a bit embarrassed to always carry around my pill bottles everywhere. I take 6 daily meds, various sizes. These have 7 compartments, 3 larger, 4 smaller. One of my pills is longer and bigger around than a Tylenol 500mg gelcap. One larger compartment holds exactly 8, oriented sideways. All my other pills are much smaller, so I can easily fit 8 or more in the other compartments. I use the 7th for Tylenol. I get to be the hero when I pull some out of my pink pill case for a coworker suffering a headache. I don’t know how many times it’s come in handy, just for that alone.

The container for the pills comes out of the carry case, so it’s easier to clean. The fact that you get two is also a nice bonus. You can still use one while you’re waiting on one to dry after washing.

I love(!) that it latches shut. I don’t have to worry about it coming open in my purse. (Meds are expensive, don’t want to lose any...) That was one reason I didn’t want the regular kind you find at drug stores, since they don’t seem secure.

I don’t notice any kind of odor, other than a faint plastic smell, but that’s everything when it’s new. There’s absolutely nothing flimsy about this. Even the inner pill holder feels tougher than I was expecting. Everything latches with a nice, audible “snap,” but they aren’t hard to open, which is a wonder.

My only “complaint” (if you can even call it that), is that the compartment on the far right is sliiiiightly smaller than the other two larger compartments. I think it’s because the edges are rounded. This would only be a problem if you needed to stuff all three with an exact number of larger pills, though. When I was trying to fit 8 of my largest pills, the lid to the inner compartment wouldn’t close, so I moved them to the middle larger compartment and that solved that.

Over all, these are fantastic for carrying around your pills without rattling every time you move, and I could see how they’d be great for traveling, though I haven’t taken them on a plane yet (I fully intend to!). I cut the amount of space taken up by pills in my purse waaaaay down. No more pill bottles!

title: An excellent help to sleepers bothered by external noise and light!
text:
I have sleeping issues so I get some shut-eye when I'm able, day or night. I bought these because they also had the Bluetooth connectivity as well so I'm able to fall asleep to a baseball game or music or white noise. It really helps to mask the noise of cars driving through the neighborhood. Since I have the music or whatever on a timer I generally use these for a couple of hours at a time. I generally charge them every two or three days which is just fine. I don't think I've ever run out of battery. They're comfortable and easily size adjusted with the Velcro/elastic straps. Light is 99% blocked; only a tiny bit is visible right around the flare of my nostrils. I don't even notice unless I'm looking for it. Sound is fine. These aren't high-end headphones, and I didn't expect them to be. Probably on a par with an old transistor radio you used to listen to the ballgame on while sitting on the back porch. (If that's unfamiliar sounding to you, that's an unfortunate loss on your part.)

To improve this, I can only really think of three small things: 1. Put something like fake fur along the lower border so that the curves will be cushioned and the tiny light leaks will be absorbed. 2. Make the pockets for the speakers smaller so they don't have as much room to shift around. They generally stay put but sometimes will shift around a bit. 3. Move the charging port to someplace besides the front eye. Granted, this is more stylistic than anything else, but it would look much cleaner without the tan piece of leather. At least maybe color it black. (3a. Consider also changing the layout of the buttons to be more readily identified by touch. The on/off/pairing button in the middle is fine but the volume up and down on either side are about five millimeters away and don't have any easy means of location unless you know exactly what you want to do.)

But overall these are totally worth it and I would certainly buy them again!

title: Great product at a great price!
text:
I've been taking inulin regularly for a couple of years and have tried at least half-a-dozen different brands, but this is the best I've found. Here's why:

Bang for your buck: I take it every day, so being able to buy two large containers in one shot is a real advantage. With other brands, I constantly had to have it on order. Also, the price is significantly better.

The flavor: The flavor is extremely light and pleasant. It's sweet, and tastes a bit like toasted marshmallows. Some of the others I've tried had no flavor (these seem to clump more) and some were slightly chemically (I threw those away). I actually enjoy the subtle sweet/toasty flavor this gives to almond milk. It makes it much less of a chore to take.

The dissolvability: It dissolves well in cold liquid, and even better in hot. I take it regularly in cold almond milk. It'll clump a bit if you're not vigorous and immediate in your stirring, but, compared to other brands I've tried, it dissolves extremely well. I do not enjoy clumps of fiber in my beverages, so this is important to me.

Effectiveness: I find it difficult to gauge things like this, but it seems to work as well as any other brand of inulin I've ever tried.

Overall, this is an awesome product at a great price. I've ordered it several times (and will continue to do so) and have never had a problem. The shipping is fast, and the price is right.

title: Great shaver for the money.
text:
This shaver is pretty good. I was looking for something that could quickly change from a shaver to beard/hair trimmer and nose hair trimmer. This one had it all. Comparable trimmers were quadruple the price!
The battery life is excellent and the digital read out screen on it looks high end and an unexpected touch for the price. The shaver itself is good. I would not say it's great but given the price it's good. It takes several passes over the same area to get all the hair, no biggie but probably wouldn't be an issue with more expensive shavers.
The attachment system is great and is a breeze. Simply twist and lock and it changes from my most commonly used trimmers in seconds. The hair/beard trimmer without a guard only works ok, it does not shave very close to the skin and sometimes leaves stubborn sideburn hair. The nose hair trimmers work very well. This thing is also waterproof, which again given the price point is surprising.
Lastly the build quality is good. It is very quiet and I have had no issues with it's functionality yet. The only knock I have against it is the materials are very plasticy and the shaver feels very light. I'm not sure about the longevity or how this thing will look in a year with a cheap feeling exterior but we will see? They chose to use a metalic paint on the outside to make it look metal which it is not. They should have done straight black as I feel it would age better. I have a feeling this cheap metal paint will eventually crack, scratch and chip, but again we will see?
All in all a good shaver for the price!

title: Excellent!  Helps with specific problem.
text:
I'm leaving a review for this product because I believe the very negative review was rather unjustified, in my opinion.

My husband has been taking this product on an as-need basis for years. He gets a specific condition that enables us to know whether a probiotic product actually works or not. This one is very, very good and is more reasonably priced than most others. We have tried many that don't work.

If you get canker sores (small ulcers) in your mouth after eating acid-type foods such as too much tomato sauces, walnuts, or rancid oils in nuts, etc.; try this product. My husband has had this painful problem since he was a kid. The doctors did nothing for him. When we married many years ago, I got him on a product such as this (not made anymore) and his pain and sores would disappear in 2-3 days (depending on how soon he started taking them). Without this product, it takes 3 painful weeks for them to disappear. His problem is a good test for us to determine whether or not these types of products work or not.

The only reason he doesn't take them regularly is because he is anti-health supplements unless I can prove without a doubt he needs them due to a condition. I, on the other hand, intend to use these regularly for my problems. My own review got me motivated!

Hope this helps. Thank you.

title: Good Product
text: As I was recently diagnosed with Celiac Disease, which plays havoc on the small bowel, I read that a probiotic would help. I picked this product because of the 13 billion bacteria and the variety of types. I found the price reasonable and the delivery charge minimal. I have found that it does even things out and quieten down the activity in the bowel. My husband has started to take it and and has found the same. I do believe that a sluggish bowel can allow the overgrowth of bad bacteria and a surpressed immune system cannot fight back alone.

title: Excellent for acid reflux
text:
I have acid reflux and cannot tolerate eating acidic foods. I used to eat a lot of yogurt, but these days, I can't even eat Greek yogurt without it hurting my stomach. This supplement provides all those active organisms to be found in yogurt and then some, without irritating my stomach.

One capsule of the supplement contains 13 billion organisms, consisting of L. Rhamnosus, L. Casei, L. Acidophilus, L. Plantarum, L. Bulgaricus, L. Salvarius, Enterococcus Faecium, S. Themophilus, B. Longum, and B. Breve. These organisms are being studied for their possible beneficial effect on diarrhea, lactose intolerance, colon cancer, cholesterol, and blood pressure.

It also contains 300 mg of Fructo-Oliogosaccharides (FOS), which functions as a prebiotic. Prebiotics are what the probiotic organisms eat, so it's supposed to stimulate the growth of all those good organisms in the capsule.

I don't know about all the extravagent health claims. What I can say from my own experience is that my stomach is calmer since I've been taking this supplement, and except for a few times when I overindulged, I haven't had much trouble with the acid reflux. In fact, since I started this supplement, I've stopped taking Prevacid. I definitely would recomment this supplement as "Worth A Try" to anyone with acid reflux. Just remember to keep it in the refrigerator-once you open it, it has to stay cold.

title: Don't buy this probiotic if you're sugar-sensitive

title: made me sick
text: Hopefully whoever reads this review does their research on probiotics in general as I didn't do mine hence why I'm probably giving this such a poor review.  As you may already be aware, different brands have different strains of 'good bacteria', and cheaper brands especially can cause problems such as an upset stomach.  When I first started taking these at the minimum dose (only 1 a day, always with a meal) I would notice my appetite would go from relatively full to very hungry almost immediately, where as before my stomach would feel more empty over a much longer duration.  No big deal, I figured my body was trying to adjust.  Then around 6+/- days into taking these I started having a cramped stomach an hour or so after going out for a beer or two, possibly what could have triggered the stomach ache since I've heard some craft beers contain probiotics in the yeast (correct me if I'm wrong, I've also heard this is filtered out in the brewing process).  I did not take my probiotic the same day I drank and that night, I went to sleep hoping my stomach would feel better in the morning.  I got up around 1am and went to the bathroom, I could not go and wanted so bad to throw up but couldn't.  I was having cold sweats looking super flushed and almost passed out on the bathroom floor.  The stomach ache was so debilitating, it was VERY similar to the time my appendix ruptured, and I was afraid this time it could be something unrelated to the probiotics, like my spleen.  I didn't know what was going on at the time and stumbled into the other room to wake up my gf.  Slowly over the next 3 days I was able to go, only ate a bare minimum of 1 meal a day with water and a small cup of coffee which is very unusual for me as I always have a big appetite.  Finally I woke up today and things seem to be back to normal.  I read up on stomach aches and probiotic uses online and they say this is why it is so important to get the right brand (I heard Align at Costco is a good brand).  Several people who had this problem (who did not cite drinking) said these stomach pains lasted a week or more.  I find it hard to believe that just ~1L of beer could cause such a reaction but I guess it's possible this was due to the bacteria in the beer.  Anyway I am scared to take any more of these, so do your research especially if you drink.

title: Gel nail polish that rivals any you’d find in a salon!
text: Our family has a house full of fingernails and toenails that are always being painted.  Finding a set that provides colors we all like, economical options, long lasting finishes, and full kits with not just the colors, but also the base and top coats is a challenge.  There are many options online and at the store, and Pine brand gel nail polish has become a favorite of ours. We like having the base coat, a light colored finish coat, and then the option of ending with either a glossy or matte finish coat, all from one kit and from one company.  I have used other company’s products from start to finish and while mixing the brands from base to finish coat, and the gel nails still look nice.  Using the products in this kit, and then also with other Pine brand colors, simply provides a long lasting finish that is much cheaper than going to the salon.  Pine advertises that they can provide a high quality finish with just one color coat, and that is true, however, a two-coat color finish is much better.  We typically get two to three weeks on our fingernails, and even a bit longer on our toenails.  I like using the matte finish on the green colors, but the rest in my family prefer the glossy and pinks.  Regardless, Pine provides a great product and this kit should definitely be part of your supplies.  We love them, and so will you!

title: What a great product! We love it!
text:
We bought this system to replace the shower head on our Danze Bannockburn oil rubbed bronze shower head. Boy are we happy with the purchase!

First of all the finish is pretty much and exact match. Whew!!

Secondly, we were really impressed with the quality of the whole system. The shower heads, the control valve, the hose, the grab bar, and the height adjuster are all high quality pieces. They all seem adequately rugged and the finish appears durable (not one nick or scratch after 3 months of use so far). We were really impressed to find so many pieces that were machined out of metal and NOT cast out of plastic. Every piece fit perfectly. Every hole and every thread was perfectly manufactured. Installation was a breeze.

The spray provided by the shower heads is far superior to the Danze heads that we had been using.

Adjusting the grab bar spayer height is easy, simple and it holds its adjustment. (many of the competitors use cheap plastic in this area and rely on the friction of an o-ring to hold the sprayer).

Quite honestly, I feel I should have paid more for the Mariner product.

If everything made in the USA were this quality, we would all be a lot better off.

title: Great for the price paid

We also shower our dogs with this so a longer hose would have been a bonus. I have made an initial search for a longer replacement hose but am having trouble finding one in oil rubbed bronze.

title: I haven't tried other showerheads, but they can't be better than this.
text: I know it may be more than some are willing to pay.  However, this is worth every dollar thrown at it.  This product has the highest craftsmanship and is built to last a lifetime.  I love the finish on this.  I installed this myself in less than 30 minutes.  One reviewer made me think you couldn't run both heads at the same time, which wasn't a concern of mine), but that's just not true.  You can select either head or both at the same time.  The only concern I would have is the adjusting bar portion is a lil tight and has plastic to protect the finish.  If you were hasty when adjusting though you could scratch metal on metal and ruin the finish.  But I wouldn't buy anything else.  This is perfect the last thing I mentioned would only be a worry for people adjust all the time and don't take care of things (kids).  Very happy with my purchase.

title: NICE Quality... poor information
text:
For the money you cannot beat the quality of this item.

I only have 2 complaints.
1) after installing the down spout from the wall you have to slide the escution up over it against the shower wall. In my case it fit very tight and ended up scratching or scaring the nicely finished downspout.
2) the manufacturer doesn't give you the size information for the holes needed to drill into your tile. I contacted them and they provided me the wrong size, so I bought the wrong size bit from HD and had to go back again to get the proper sized tile bit. 1/4" glass and tile bit is what you'll need.

The shower set looks great (except for those scratches) and the family loves how it functions. It is still new but has a heavy quality feel about it and I think it will last a while. The great advantage for a family is you can put one head down low for the kids and one up high for the adults. Or... you can have both heads on at the same time (fancy).

Hope this helps... good luck!

title: I love this item
text:
This personal shower set up is EXCELLENT. A quality product. The shower heads are BOTH great! The bar is substantial, don't drop it on your foot or in your tub. The holder for the hand shower is very adjustable and easy to use. The kit comes with a manual shut off for just before the hand shower. The shower arm diverter is a THREE way diverter. 1. Personal shower. 2. Main shower head. 3. BOTH at once! Since the head for the personal shower can be used in it's holder as a shower head, you can run them both at once, getting a ton of water over a wide area. The diverter itself operates so easy and smoothly that I was pleasantly surprised since my previous push pull diverter worked so hard my wife couldn't operate it. This one turns like a valve with a lever handle, very easy.

edit: I was wrong about the hose. The one that came with this shower is the good one. Very flexible yet hangs straight.

I would 100% recommend this shower set up to anyone. High quality, beautiful looking and very functional. It's the best deal for the money I've seen. It is equivalent to others at TWICE the price.

title: Great way to turn your shower into a dual-head setup
text: I installed this in my home to replace an old single shower head, and it is a great product. I was worried that you could only select one head at a time, but this shower head system will spray out of both simultaneously. We have it set up as a "dual shower head" in our shower. The shower heads themselves are selectable with massage and normal settings, and on the normal setting, they put out powerful, comfortable streams of water. Installation was a piece of cake, but you may need to pick up a spade bit for drilling two small holes in your tile, to put up the rod. The bronze finish matched our existing bronze hardware, and we haven't had any problems with scratching, corrosion or wear. We have fairly hard water in our house, but when we get build-up on the flexible hose it comes right off with a little bit of CLR. This is an easy way to turn your shower into a dual-head setup without calling a plumber.

title: Easy to install but read all of the reviews here and learn from other's mistakes
text:
Looks good. It is noticeably pinkish though compared to all of the other oil rubbed bronze in the house. The shower hose could be longer like 84 inches for my needs so I'll just get a shower arm extension for the handheld.

Others have complained about the plate scratching the shower arm during installation. It will if you install the arm first and then slide the plate on the long way. Here's a hint, unscrew your old shower arm and make note of how far the plate was on the old one. Then, push this new plate on to the new arm starting at the end that will be installed in the wall up to the same distance OR less. THEN screw in the new arm. You'll never see the scratches that are created when installing the plate because they'll be behind the wall.

This was a replacement for an older shower kit I had and I found that the wall pole on this new one was too long for the holes that were already drilled. So rather than drilling new holes, I used a hacksaw to cut the length of the new pole and it now fits fine. You have to unscrew the pole from one of the wall adapters, the other is just a press fit.

title: Much more comfortable flight!
text:
Flying every so often from Hawaii to the East Coast, I have found that the padding in airline seats leaves a great deal to be desired. Some seats are so worn, there's no foam left. After my last trip, enduring nearly 9 hours of torture, I decided to do something about it. The Corflex Medic-Air Seat Cushion worked out perfectly.

With a little trial and error, I found that very little air is needed for comfort. A couple of breaths and you are set to go. The little plug stayed in, and there was no leaks. Prior to landing, I rolled it up, squeezing the air out, and folded it back into its travel case. The case is big enough that you don't have to struggle getting it to fit again, thankfully.

For the price, this little gem should be in everyone's carry-on!

Only two uses later, it popped two more holes which I also patched. Next, I tried testing it indoors in a safer environment. It popped yet another hole after only about 3 minutes on an office chair.

I am now using a Therm-a-rest camp seat cushion that is made to be tough enough to sit on a rock. While it is not as shock absorbent as this cushion was, it has lasted longer.

If you do want the softest seat cushion, you would have to buy these in bulk.

title: Pretty good little spa
text: This little...spa wont replace an $[money] jacuzzi with 25 jets.  Dont kid yourself.  You've got 2 nozzles which can either shoot bubbly water or straight water.  The bubbles are good, but I think my tub may be too small and poorly designed to have much use for the bubbles, but they are powerful enough to give a nice little massage to my legs.  Also on about 60% of bathtub/shower combinations, you'll be mounting this little beauty on the side of your tub so yes, only one side of your body will get massaged at once... DUH!  I dont like bubblemats because they blow cold air where cold air just shouldnt go.  And you cant beat the price!  The filter does tend to clog a lot though if you do what I do and shave your legs in the tub and use the jets to clean your razor  (works really good for that!).  Also the plug if you're not careful you'll trip its circuitbreaker and will be meandering about your bathroom nude wondering why your spa isnt working.  I cant say anything bad about this little spa.  Its powerful enough for my tub, it gives a nice light relaxing foot or leg massage if I position myself right, and its not terribly noisy like my previous bubblemat was (how relaxing is something that sounds like a jackhammer!)  Just a nice delicate hum that wont overpower other sounds in your bathroom.

title: Great relief for my knee...
text:
I purchased this because I recently injured my knee and am now experiencing arthritis. Upon opening the package, I checked it for leaks and defects. There were none, construction was good. The fit was nice and adjustable too so it was pretty comfortable. My only initial disappointment was that no instructions or guides came with it. Was just a wrapped product in a box.
The first test was done with freezing. Everything was great. The gel stayed consistent and didn't harden. It did stay cold for a very long time. Be sure to wear it above clothes due to extreme temperatures and condensation.
It performed to my expectations.
Second, it is advertised as a hot pack as well. The problem is that there are no instructions not a temperature guide on the product like most hot packs have. Having experience with hot packs, I had to use the info provided on Amazon description along with my sense of how to microwave hot packs. I put it for 30 secs at a time. I noticed that the area hearing was inconsistent due to the gel squeezing from one section to another. I took it out, let it cool and then laid it flat to evenly distribute the gel. Tried again and this worked for better distribution of heating. Again , you must apply this over thicker clothing or you will burn yourself. It was very soothing radiant heat and held up fine to the test. Keep in mind though, if you are in the middle of hot/ cold therapy you need to be able to switch quickly. You'll have to have two devices, whether it's two of these or another device. Switching this over will not happen instantaneously as needed obviously.
I was able to receive this product at a steeply reduced price in exchange for my honest and unbiased review. The reason that I'm unable to give this 5 star is because there were no instructions included, which could be harmful to those who don't take time and caution using the hot pack. Also, I think they can improve the pack design to prevent cold spots with a proper quilting design. That would have kept the gel evenly distributed. Otherwise, the product has held up well and performed as advertised. My knee appreciates it.

Update: the item instructions were emailed out shortly after purchase, however was caught in my spam filter. Instructions are provided but not with the product.

title: Perfect brush for those of us who feel the need to scour their teeth
text:
I don't know why, but I tend to brush my teeth as hard as possible when I brush. This is a bad thing - even my dentist commented on how I was wearing away my gums from brushing so hard. I found this brush by chance at a dollar store and when I saw that it was described as a soft-bristled brush, I got it immediately. Wow, I love this brush! The bristles are so soft and dense and I can grind away at my teeth with it and not damage them.

I wanted another one when my first one got too worn out, but of course, the store I got my original one from no longer had them, so I took to Google and found them here. I had no idea it was a children's toothbrush! The tiny brush end should have been a dead giveaway, but I don't care! I was glad to be able to buy these in bulk and I will never go back to using a normal stiff-bristled toothbrush when this one lets me continue my bad dental habits without the damage I was doing before.

I'm sure this is a great brush for kids, but if you're any age and have a tendency to scrub your teeth as hard as possible, I highly recommend this brush. My teeth are just as clean as before and not nearly as sore.
